Solicitation Description:  

The Goose Creek Consolidated Independent School District (GCCISD) is soliciting proposals from qualified and experienced vendors to provide the pickup, transportation, data destruction, recycling, resale, and environmentally responsible disposal of surplus technology equipment on an as-needed basis.
